description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Purchasing Info Record provides a way to interact with the [Purchasing Info Record API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_INFORECORD_PROCESS_SRV/overview). The service allows to create, read, update and delete purchasing info records, with their purchasing organization and plant data, purchase order texts and pricing conditions.
key-features: Create, read, update and delete purchasing info records for supplier and material combinations
Maintain purchasing organization and plant data, including purchase order texts
Manage pricing conditions, condition validities, supplementary conditions and condition scales
